title: Greybox
listed_note: Kept out of the in-game level list. Everything else that ships can be picked from LOAD GAME; this one is a stage for the suites to stand things on, and offering it as something to play would be offering a bug report.
scope: The test fixture, and only that. Flat ground, two gaps, one set of spikes, one enemy, one bottle of each, three crates and a flag — a stage with a known coordinate for everything a suite needs to stand something on. Not content: it is off the course, it is not what PRACTICE boots, and nothing in it is playtested.
why_note: This is the geometry First Steps had until it became the practice course. Every suite boots it (see DEFAULT_LEVEL in game/session.gd) because a fixture has to be two things a designed level is not: cheap to simulate, and still there next week. First Steps was both right up until it grew cliffs, four gates and a fight in every section, at which point half of test_game and test_combat were asserting against a level someone was editing for how it PLAYS. Put new content in a new file and leave this one alone.
note: All coordinates rescaled x2 on 2026-09-13 for the taller character sprite.
brief: Cross two gaps. Clear the spikes. Reach the flag.
camera_y_note: Pins the camera vertically, keeping the framing this greybox level was built and screenshotted with. Omit it and the camera follows the player, which is what a level with real height needs.
crates_note: Breakable targets, [x, ground_y]. Area2D only, never solid, so they cannot block or alter the platforming route. Delete this array to remove them; the attacks work without any targets present.
brews_note: The brown bottle, same [x, ground_y, bars] but against the mana bar. He spawns with three blasts of five and nothing else refills them, so this one sits on the raised platform just short of the punk: spend mana on the crates and the climb buys it back before the fight.
bottles_note: Milk, [x, ground_y, bars]. The third value is health-BAR SEGMENTS, not points: 2 means two of the bar's five. It used to be raw points, so an older level file's 50 would now read as fifty bars. Player spawns on 25 of 100 health; this one sits between the first crate and the spikes, so it is found after the player has learnt to punch and before the first real hazard.
signs_note: Painted on the background, [x, y, heading] or [x, y, heading, subtitle]. World coordinates, drawn at a fixed font size because one world unit is one logical screen pixel.
hills_note: Background hill peaks, x only. Optional: a level that omits this gets them spaced evenly across its width.
